## Why this change?

Describe the user-visible problem and intended behavior.

## Scope and verification

- [ ] One focused change, unrelated functionality preserved
- [ ] Related docs/tests updated when needed
- [ ] Build/test commands and exact outcomes listed; unrun checks labeled **not verified**
- [ ] Real app screenshots if UI changed, containing demo text only
- [ ] Keyboard latency, accessibility, privacy and editor lifecycle considered

## Critical safety checks

- [ ] Production package, signer, `brrBoard.apk` and Obtainium update scheme unchanged
- [ ] No private typed content, Clipboard, audio, credentials or keystores in this PR
- [ ] No new internet permission or network/AI dependency without owner approval

See [brrBoard CONTRIBUTING](../CONTRIBUTING.md). Review may take time; never force-push the live `main` branch.
